title: 7.17.3 Lab: Trade blows
description: Your hero and the goblin take turns: 1 attacks through the target's takeHit, the turn passes, the enemy hits back after a pause, and the battle ends with a win or a loss and R to play again.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: This is your game from 7.16.4: two fighters with full hp bars. Nothing happens yet when you press a key.
hints: If you brought your 7.16.4 work forward, your names may differ; keep yours. Where a step quotes a line, change the line of yours that does the same job.

steps.title: Take a hit, and attack
steps.instructions: In the class, below `isAlive()`, write `takeHit(n)`: `this.hp = max(this.hp - n, 0);` and then `return n;`. Below it, `attack(target, roll)`, one line: `return target.takeHit(this.power + roll);`. Nothing calls them yet, so Run looks the same.
hints: `attack` never changes `target.hp` itself: it asks the target to take the hit, and the target's `takeHit` keeps the floor at 0.

steps.title: Whose turn, and a message
steps.instructions: Below `let fighters;`, add `let turn = 0;`, `let message = '';` and `let over = false;`. In `setup()`, on the line before `newGame();`, add `randomSeed(Date.now());`. In `newGame()`, below the line that makes the fighters, set `turn = 0;`, `over = false;` and `message = 'Your turn: press 1 to attack';`. In `drawTop()`, show the message instead of the names: `text(message, 10, 24, 15, 'white');`. Run: the top says Your turn: press 1 to attack.
hints: `turn` is 0 or 1, so `fighters[turn]` is the fighter whose turn it is.

steps.title: Your attack
steps.instructions: Below the sketch's `draw()`, write `fightOver(winner)` from the reading: `over = true;`, then a message for a win (`winner === 0`) or a loss. Below it, write `attackTurn(t, roll)` from the reading: `const me = fighters[t];`, `const them = fighters[1 - t];`, the message line with `me.attack(them, roll)`, then `if (!them.isAlive()) { fightOver(t); return; }`, and last `turn = 1 - turn;`. In `draw()`, below `background(...)`, add `if (!over && turn === 0 && kb.presses('1')) attackTurn(0, floor(random(0, 4)));`. Run and press 1: the goblin loses 3 to 6 hp and the top says by how much. Press 1 again: nothing, because now it is the goblin's turn, and the goblin does not act yet.
hints: Write `fightOver` before you use it: `attackTurn` calls it the moment a fighter has no hp left.

steps.title: The enemy's turn
steps.instructions: Below `attackTurn`, write `enemyTurn()`: `if (over || turn !== 1) return;` and then `attackTurn(1, floor(random(0, 4)));`. In `attackTurn`, below `turn = 1 - turn;`, add `if (turn === 1) after(45, enemyTurn);`. Run and play: you hit, the goblin hits back a moment later, and then it is your turn again.
hints: `after(45, enemyTurn)` has no `()` after `enemyTurn`: you hand `after` the function, to run later.
Pressing 1 while the goblin is waiting does nothing, because `turn` is 1 until the goblin has hit.

steps.title: Win, lose, and R
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, below the line for key 1, add `if (kb.presses('r') && over) newGame();`. Play until someone wins. To reach the end fast, in `newGame()`, on the line below the one that makes the fighters, add `fighters[1].hp = 3;`: one hit wins. Then try `fighters[0].hp = 1;` instead, and lose. Press R each time. Delete the test line when you are done.
hints: A test line goes BELOW the line that makes the fighters: above it, the new fighters would be made after your change and undo it.

requirements.title: takeHit never below 0
requirements.description: takeHit lowers hp by the hit but never below 0. Help: 7.3.8 (Lab: takeHit with a floor at zero) and 7.17.1 (Reading: A method that hits another object, and after())

requirements.title: attack goes through the target's takeHit
requirements.description: attack is handed the target and makes it take the hit through its own takeHit, and the game calls attack. Help: 7.17.1 (Reading: A method that hits another object, and after())

requirements.title: The turn passes
requirements.description: After a hit, the turn goes to the other fighter: 0 to 1, 1 to 0. Help: 7.17.1 (Reading: A method that hits another object, and after())

requirements.title: The enemy acts after a pause
requirements.description: The enemy's turn is handed to after, to run a moment later. Help: 7.17.1 (Reading: A method that hits another object, and after())

requirements.title: A win or a loss ends it, and R restarts
requirements.description: When a fighter has no hp left the battle is over, and once it is over R starts a new game. Help: 7.17.1 (Reading: A method that hits another object, and after())
requirements.hint: if (!them.isAlive()) { fightOver(t); return; }   and   if (kb.presses('r') && over) newGame();

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Trade blows". The task: give Fighter takeHit(n), which lowers hp but never below 0 and returns the damage, and attack(target, roll), which hits the target through its takeHit for power plus roll; keep turn (0 or 1), a message and an over flag; on your turn 1 attacks with a roll of 0 to 3, the turn passes with turn = 1 - turn (or another correct way), and the enemy's turn comes after(45, enemyTurn); when a fighter has no hp left the battle is over with a win or loss message, and R starts a new game. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.description: A win or loss ends it, and R restarts.
